title: Adobe brings AI agents and new creative tools to Photoshop, Premiere, and Firefly
slides: Can Adobe's new AI agents replace your editing instincts?
Agents launched across Photoshop, Premiere, and Firefly simultaneously.
But they work inside Adobe's ecosystem, not standalone.
Teams will need to rebuild workflows around agent-driven tasks.
Test one agent on a real project this week.
thread_text:
1. Adobe's AI agents: editing instincts replaced?

Agents launched across Photoshop, Premiere, and Firefly simultaneously, but they're locked inside Adobe's ecosystem. No standalone tools.

2. Locked inside Adobe's walled garden

These agents can't operate outside Adobe apps, so you're tied to their subscription and file formats. Flexibility takes a hit.

3. Workflows will never be the same

Teams must rebuild processes around agent-driven tasks. The old way of editing file-by-file is gone.

4. The hidden cost of automation

Agents may speed up tasks, but they require new oversight. You'll trade manual edits for supervising AI output.

5. Test one agent this week

Pick a real project and run a single agent on it. Does it save time or just shift the work? Try it and see.
